name: Omaotp
author: qempexe
description: One-time codes (TOTP) in the Omarchy bar, from an encrypted vault on your computer: countdown rings, one-click copy that clears itself, and a window docked to the bar or popped out.

barWidget.description: TOTP authenticator with an encrypted local vault

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Follow theme matches your Omarchy theme live. Window borders takes the accent from your theme's window border. Custom lets you choose the background, text and accent. Monochrome removes every hue.

schema.label: Custom background
schema.description: Background, text and accent, used as you pick them. Text too close to the background is made darker or lighter, keeping its tint, only as much as it needs to read. A #rrggbb color, used when Colors is Custom.

schema.label: Custom text
schema.description: Background, text and accent, used as you pick them. Text too close to the background is made darker or lighter, keeping its tint, only as much as it needs to read. A #rrggbb color, used when Colors is Custom.

schema.label: Custom accent
schema.description: Background, text and accent, used as you pick them. Text too close to the background is made darker or lighter, keeping its tint, only as much as it needs to read. A #rrggbb color, used when Colors is Custom.

schema.label: Text
schema.description: Always readable keeps your theme's text color, and switches to black or white when the window is too light or too dark for it. My text color uses the Text color from Custom colors.

schema.label: Card style
schema.description: Soft fills the account rows lightly, outline draws a border only, flat has neither.

schema.label: Spacing
schema.description: How much air there is between things.

schema.label: Roundness
schema.description: 0 is square, 20 is very round.

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: 1 is normal, 1.25 is a quarter bigger.

schema.label: Issuer icons
schema.description: The logo of known services (GitHub, Google, Discord…) on each row. Off shows the first letter.

schema.label: Split codes in two
schema.description: Show 123 456 instead of 123456. The copied code never has the space.

schema.label: Window width
schema.description: How wide Omaotp opens.

schema.label: Window height
schema.description: How tall Omaotp opens.

schema.label: Open as
schema.description: Where the bar button opens Omaotp. You can always pop it out or dock it back from the header.

schema.label: Window outline
schema.description: Draw the edge in your window border's colors instead of a plain neutral line.

schema.label: Outline gradient
schema.description: Use the window border's whole gradient, at its angle, when it has more than one color.

schema.label: Outline color
schema.description: The one color the outline takes when it isn't a gradient.

schema.label: Window tint
schema.description: How much of the accent washes over the background. 0 keeps it plain.

schema.label: Window opacity
schema.description: 100 is solid.

schema.label: Lock after
schema.description: Minutes after the window closes before the vault locks itself.

schema.label: Lock when the window closes
schema.description: Lock straight away instead of waiting. Every open then asks for the master password.

schema.label: Clear the clipboard after
schema.description: Seconds before a copied code is cleared, if the clipboard still holds it.

schema.label: Hide codes until hovered
schema.description: Codes show as dots until the mouse is over their row, for when someone may be looking.

schema.label: Bar button shows
schema.description: What the bar shows for the first account while the vault is open. Drag an account to the top of the list to choose it.

schema.label: Middle click
schema.description: What a middle click on the bar button does.
